dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, high-contrast light-colored closed-loop 'O' and 'C' shapes with jagged, serrated outer perimeters. The gradient transition is sharp from the dark coat to the high-intensity ring perimeter, with a slightly darker, mottled interior within each annulus.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, small-diameter light-colored pixel clusters located primarily along the lower lateral boundary and cervical region, lacking internal gradients or hollow centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent central lateral rings form an irregular quadrilateral. The two most dorsal rings are horizontally aligned, while the ventral pair is offset posteriorly at approximately a 45-degree angle.
